name: Silver Marches
title: Silver Marches: Luruar
description: The Silver Marches, often called Luruar, is a confederation of cities and settlements in the north-central part of the continent.
wiki: Founded by High Lady Alustriel Silverhand, the Silver Marches is a beacon of hope and cooperation. It includes the magnificent city of Silverymoon, as well as several dwarf-holds like Mithral Hall and Sundabar.

popup.title: Silverymoon
popup.description: The Gem of the North, a center of art, culture, and magic.

popup.title: Mithral Hall
popup.description: The legendary ancestral home of Clan Battlehammer.

popup.title: Sundabar
popup.description: A powerful fortress city built atop an ancient dwarven citadel.
